description: Defines the 'TranscribeCommand' command-line tool for audio/video transcription, including command-line argument parsing, initiating speech transcription, and output handling.

classes.name: TranscribeCommand
classes.description: A command-line utility to transcribe media files using speech recognition, with configurable options for locale, output format, and censorship.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously performs the transcription process: reading input audio, transcribing speech, and writing or printing the output.
